skipped.name: Park River
skipped.reason: park-river-ct exists (Hartford), a 0.3 km stub at the mouth; the open branches are added below

skipped.name: Burr Creek
skipped.reason: OSM has only a label node; the creek is the head of Black Rock Harbor, inside the black-rock-harbor-ct polygon (alias there)

skipped.name: Chicopee River
skipped.reason: chicopee-river-ma already runs from Three Rivers to the Connecticut (bbox west edge -72.623)

skipped.name: Nashua River
skipped.reason: nashua-river-ma runs from the North/South Nashua confluence in Lancaster to the NH line

skipped.name: Little Mystic Channel
skipped.reason: not in OSM by name or shape; it lies inside the boston-inner-harbor-ma polygon (alias there)

skipped.name: Fore River
skipped.reason: fore-river-me runs the whole estuary, Portland and South Portland shores (bbox -70.312..-70.200)

skipped.name: Kenduskeag Stream

waters.name: East Creek
waters.note: OSM names the reach below the Mendon Brook junction (through Rutland City to Otter Creek) Mendon Brook; USGS and the VT DEC reports call it East Creek, so that reach is included

waters.name: North Branch Winooski River
aliases: North Branch of the Winooski River

waters.name: Mount Hope Bay
waters.note: OSM has Mount Hope Bay only as a label node: the polygon is the OSM coastline closed at the Mount Hope, Sakonnet River and Braga bridges, split at the MA/RI line (OSM state relations)

waters.name: New Haven Harbor
waters.note: OSM has New Haven Harbor only as a label node: the polygon is the OSM coastline closed at the I-95 (Pearl Harbor Memorial) and Tomlinson bridges and by a line from Lighthouse Point to Bradley Point (ends snapped to the coastline)

waters.name: Yellow Mill Pond
waters.note: Not in OSM by name: the OSM coastline water of Bridgeport Harbor's eastern arm, from the fork with the Pequonnock (a line across the channel mouth, ends snapped to the coastline) to the head of the pond

waters.name: Black Rock Harbor
waters.note: Not in OSM by name: the OSM coastline water north of a line from Black Rock to Fayerweather Island (ends snapped to the coastline), Burr Creek at its head included

waters.name: Greenwich Harbor
waters.note: OSM has Greenwich Harbor only as a label node: the OSM coastline water north of a line across the harbour mouth (ends snapped to the coastline)

waters.name: Park River Conduit
waters.note: the buried Park River in Hartford (OSM ways named Park River, mostly culvert), from the North/South Branch confluence to the Connecticut; park-river-ct is a 0.3 km piece of it

waters.name: Mount Hope Bay
waters.note: OSM has Mount Hope Bay only as a label node: the polygon is the OSM coastline closed at the Mount Hope, Sakonnet River and Braga bridges, split at the MA/RI line (OSM state relations)

waters.name: Boston Inner Harbor
waters.note: Not in OSM by name: the polygon is the OSM sea between the coastline, the Charlestown, Tobin, McArdle/Chelsea Street and Fort Point Channel bridges and a line from Castle Island to Logan Airport (ends snapped to the coastline); it holds the Little Mystic and Reserved Channels

waters.name: Back Cove
waters.note: OSM has Back Cove only as a label node: the polygon is the OSM coastline closed at Tukey's Bridge

waters.name: Portland Harbor
waters.note: Not in OSM by name: the polygon is the OSM sea between the coastline, the Casco Bay Bridge (the Fore River above it is fore-river-me) and a line from Spring Point to Fish Point (ends snapped to the coastline)
